data.long_meaning: A tender and soft name derived from the Arabic word 'Lam' which means 'tongue' and 'Yaa' which is an Arabic exclamation meaning 'O Allah'. This name signifies tenderness, gentleness and softness. The name Lamiyaa carries the meaning “Tender, Soft, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lamiyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody tender, soft, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
